synthesizedFacts.fact: The skin barrier, also known as the stratum corneum, is the outermost layer of the skin composed of corneocytes and lipids.
A damaged skin barrier can lead to symptoms such as dryness, redness, itchiness, and increased sensitivity.
Common causes of skin barrier damage include over-exfoliation, harsh skincare products, and environmental factors.
